Q: What is this website for?
A: This domain is used exclusively for documentation examples and does not provide any actual services or products.

Q: What is this website for?
A: This domain is used in documentation examples and does not require permission. It is not a live service.

Q: What is the price of the Swift?
A: The Swift starts at Rs. 6.49 lakh, ex-showroom (indicative). The final on-road price adds registration, insurance and taxes for your city - call our sales team on +91 98765 43210 for an exact quote.

Q: What is the starting price of the WagonR?
A: The WagonR starts at Rs. 5.79 lakh, ex-showroom (indicative). It is one of the most affordable 5-seater family cars at Velocity Motors.

Q: What is the price of the Baleno?
A: The Baleno starts at Rs. 6.66 lakh, ex-showroom (indicative). Baleno is a premium hatchback sold in Sigma, Delta, Zeta and Alpha variants.

Q: Which is the cheapest car at your showroom?
A: The Alto K10 is our most affordable car, starting at Rs. 4.23 lakh, ex-showroom (indicative). The Celerio, starting at Rs. 5.64 lakh, is the next step up.

Q: What is the price of the Hyundai Creta?
A: The Creta starts at Rs. 11.11 lakh, ex-showroom (indicative). The Creta is a 5-seater SUV available in petrol and diesel.

Q: What is the price of the Defender?
A: The Defender starts at Rs. 1.04 crore, ex-showroom (indicative). The Defender is a luxury 4x4 available in 90, 110 and 130 body styles.

Q: What is the price of the Venue?
A: The Venue starts at Rs. 7.94 lakh, ex-showroom (indicative). The Venue is a compact 5-seater SUV, good for city driving.

Q: Are there any offers going on this month?
A: Yes. This month you can get cashback up to Rs. 15,000 on select models, an exchange bonus up to Rs. 25,000 on your old car, and a corporate discount of Rs. 5,000 on hatchbacks and Rs. 10,000 on SUVs.

Q: How much cashback can I get on a new car?
A: You can get cashback up to Rs. 15,000 on select models this month at Velocity Motors. The exact cashback depends on the model and variant you choose.

Q: What is the corporate discount?
A: Employees of our listed corporate companies get a corporate discount of Rs. 5,000 on hatchbacks and Rs. 10,000 on SUVs. Carry your company ID card or a salary slip to claim it.

Q: Is there any discount on SUVs like the Thar and Scorpio-N?
A: Yes. SUVs like the Thar and Scorpio-N are eligible for the corporate discount of Rs. 10,000, and you can add an exchange bonus up to Rs. 25,000 if you exchange your old car.

Q: What is the price of the Ertiga? Is it a 7-seater?
A: The Ertiga starts at Rs. 8.97 lakh, ex-showroom (indicative). Yes, the Ertiga is a 7-seater family car.

Q: What is the price of the Fortuner and the Innova Crysta?
A: The Fortuner starts at Rs. 35.37 lakh and the Innova Crysta starts at Rs. 19.99 lakh, ex-showroom (indicative). The Fortuner is a 7-seater and the Innova Crysta comes in 7-seater and 8-seater options.

Q: If the price increases after I book, do I have to pay more?
A: No. The ex-showroom price written on your booking form is protected for 30 days from booking. If there is a price hike in that period, you still pay the booked price.

Q: What are the variants of the Swift?
A: The Swift comes in 4 variants - LXi, VXi, ZXi and ZXi+. Prices start at Rs. 6.49 lakh, ex-showroom (indicative).

Q: Which colours are available in the Swift?
A: The Swift is available in Pearl Arctic White, Splendid Silver, Magma Grey, Luster Blue, Novel Orange and Burning Red. Colour availability can vary by variant.

Q: What are the variants of the Baleno?
A: The Baleno comes in 4 variants - Sigma, Delta, Zeta and Alpha. Prices start at Rs. 6.66 lakh, ex-showroom (indicative).

Q: Which colours are available in the Baleno?
A: The Baleno is available in Nexa Blue, Pearl Arctic White, Grandeur Grey, Splendid Silver, Opulent Red and Luxe Beige. Colour availability can vary by variant.

Q: Which 7-seater cars do you sell?
A: Our 7-seater options are the Ertiga (7 seats), Scorpio-N (6 or 7 seats), Fortuner (7 seats), Innova Crysta (7 or 8 seats) and the Defender (5 to 7 seats depending on body style).

Q: How many seats does the Jimny have?
A: The Jimny is a 4-seater. The Jimny is a compact 4x4 off-roader starting at Rs. 12.74 lakh, ex-showroom (indicative).

Q: Which colours are available in the Defender?
A: The Defender is available in Pangea Green, Santorini Black, Fuji White, Eiger Grey and Gondwana Stone. Some colours are offered only on select body styles.

Q: What are the body styles of the Defender?
A: The Defender comes in 3 body styles - 90, 110 and 130. Seating ranges from 5 to 7 seats depending on the body style chosen.

Q: Is the Thar a 4x4? How many seats does it have?
A: Yes, the Thar is a 4x4 off-roader and it is a 4-seater. The Thar starts at Rs. 13.59 lakh, ex-showroom (indicative).

Q: Does the Creta come in diesel?
A: Yes, the Creta is available in both petrol and diesel engine options. The Creta is a 5-seater SUV starting at Rs. 11.11 lakh, ex-showroom (indicative).

Q: Which cars have a 5-star safety rating?
A: The Nexon and the Punch both carry a 5-star safety rating. The Nexon starts at Rs. 8.15 lakh and the Punch starts at Rs. 6.20 lakh, ex-showroom (indicative).

Q: Is the WagonR a 5-seater?
A: Yes, the WagonR is a 5-seater hatchback. It starts at Rs. 5.79 lakh, ex-showroom (indicative).

Q: Is the i20 a 5-seater?
A: Yes, the i20 is a premium 5-seater hatchback. The i20 starts at Rs. 7.04 lakh, ex-showroom (indicative).

Q: How many seats does the Scorpio-N have?
A: The Scorpio-N comes in 6-seater and 7-seater options. It starts at Rs. 13.99 lakh, ex-showroom (indicative).

Q: What is the mileage of the Swift?
A: The Swift gives a mileage of up to 25.75 km/l. Actual mileage depends on traffic, driving style and road conditions.

Q: What is the mileage of the WagonR in CNG?
A: The WagonR CNG gives a mileage of up to 34.05 km/kg. The WagonR petrol gives up to 25.19 km/l.

Q: What is the mileage of the Baleno?
A: The Baleno gives a mileage of up to 22.94 km/l. Actual mileage depends on traffic and driving style.

Q: Which car gives the best mileage at your showroom?
A: The Grand Vitara strong hybrid gives the best mileage at up to 27.97 km/l. Among petrol cars, the Celerio gives up to 26.68 km/l and the Swift up to 25.75 km/l.

Q: What is the mileage of the Dzire?
A: The Dzire gives a mileage of up to 25.71 km/l. The Dzire is a 5-seater sedan starting at Rs. 6.84 lakh, ex-showroom (indicative).

Q: What is the mileage of the Grand Vitara hybrid?
A: The Grand Vitara strong hybrid gives a mileage of up to 27.97 km/l. The Grand Vitara is a 5-seater SUV starting at Rs. 11.42 lakh, ex-showroom (indicative).

Q: What is the mileage of the Brezza?
A: The Brezza gives a mileage of up to 19.89 km/l. The Brezza is a 5-seater SUV starting at Rs. 8.69 lakh, ex-showroom (indicative).

Q: What is the mileage of the Jimny?
A: The Jimny gives a mileage of up to 16.94 km/l. The Jimny is a 4x4, so its mileage is lower than a regular city car.

Q: What is the mileage of the Celerio?
A: The Celerio gives a mileage of up to 26.68 km/l, one of the highest among petrol hatchbacks. The Celerio starts at Rs. 5.64 lakh, ex-showroom (indicative).

Q: What is the mileage of the Fronx?
A: The Fronx gives a mileage of up to 22.89 km/l. The Fronx is a 5-seater starting at Rs. 7.51 lakh, ex-showroom (indicative).

Q: What is the mileage of the Ertiga?
A: The Ertiga gives a mileage of up to 20.51 km/l. For a 7-seater, that is very fuel-efficient for family trips.

Q: What is the mileage of the Alto K10?
A: The Alto K10 gives a mileage of up to 24.90 km/l. The Alto K10 is our most affordable car, starting at Rs. 4.23 lakh, ex-showroom (indicative).

Q: Can I buy a car on a loan?
A: Yes. We arrange car loans through our partner banks and NBFCs with interest starting at 9.25% per year and tenure up to 7 years. Our finance desk at the showroom handles the full process.

Q: What will be the EMI for a Swift?
A: For a Swift with a Rs. 6 lakh loan over 5 years, the EMI is about Rs. 10,500 per month. Your exact EMI depends on the loan amount, tenure and interest rate offered to you.

Q: What will be the EMI for a WagonR?
A: For a WagonR with a Rs. 5 lakh loan over 5 years, the EMI is about Rs. 8,750 per month. A bigger down payment will reduce your EMI further.

Q: What will be the EMI for a Creta?
A: For a Creta with a Rs. 10 lakh loan over 5 years, the EMI is about Rs. 17,500 per month. You can choose a longer tenure of up to 7 years to lower the monthly EMI.

Q: How much down payment do I need to pay?
A: The minimum down payment is 15% of the on-road price of the car. Paying a higher down payment reduces your loan amount and your monthly EMI.

Q: What documents are needed for a car loan?
A: Salaried: Aadhaar card, PAN card, address proof, bank statements of the last 6 months, and salary slips of the last 3 months. Self-employed: Share ITR copies instead of salary slips.

Q: What is the interest rate on a car loan?
A: Car loan interest at Velocity Motors starts at 9.25% per year. The final rate depends on your credit profile and the bank you choose.

Q: For how many years can I take a car loan?
A: You can take a car loan for 1 to 7 years. A shorter tenure means a higher EMI but less total interest; a longer tenure means a lower EMI.

Q: Who is eligible for a car loan?
A: You should be between 21 and 65 years of age with a minimum monthly income of Rs. 25,000. A credit score of 700 or above helps you get the best interest rates.

Q: Can I prepay or close my car loan early?
A: Yes. You can prepay or foreclose your car loan after paying 6 EMIs. A foreclosure charge of up to 3% of the outstanding amount may apply, as per your bank's policy.

Q: How much time does loan approval take?
A: Loan approval usually takes 1 to 2 working days after you submit all documents. Our finance desk updates you at every step.

Q: I am self-employed. Can I still get a car loan?
A: Yes, self-employed customers can get a car loan. Share your ITR of the last 2 years, bank statements of the last 6 months, Aadhaar card, PAN card and address proof.

Q: Can I take a test drive before buying?
A: Yes, test drives are completely free at Velocity Motors. You can take the test drive at the showroom or at your home - just carry your driving licence.

Q: How do I book a test drive?
A: Call our sales team on +91 98765 43210 or write to care@velocitymotors.in to book a free test drive. Tell us the model and a time that suits you, any day between 10 AM and 8 PM.

Q: What is the booking amount for a car?
A: The booking amount is Rs. 11,000 for all models. It is fully refundable until delivery if you change your mind.

Q: How do I book a car?
A: Visit the showroom or call +91 98765 43210, choose your model, variant and colour, and pay the booking amount of Rs. 11,000 with your ID proof. You will get a booking form with your price and expected delivery date.

Q: Is the booking amount refundable?
A: Yes, the booking amount of Rs. 11,000 is fully refundable until delivery. If you cancel, the full amount is returned to you with no deduction.

Q: Can I test drive the Defender or the Thar?
A: Yes, free test drives are available for all models including the Defender and the Thar 4x4, subject to the car being available. Book your slot on +91 98765 43210 so we keep the car ready.

Q: What should I carry for a test drive?
A: Carry your original driving licence - it is compulsory for a test drive. Nothing else is needed, and the test drive is free.

Q: Can I change the variant or colour after booking?
A: Yes, you can change the variant or colour before your car is allotted, at no extra charge. Inform your sales advisor early, as the delivery time may change with the new choice.

Q: Can I exchange my old car for a new one?
A: Yes, we accept your old car in exchange for any new car at Velocity Motors. The evaluated value is adjusted against your new car payment.

Q: How much exchange bonus will I get?
A: You get an exchange bonus up to Rs. 25,000 over and above the evaluated value of your old car. The exact bonus depends on the new model you choose.

Q: How is the value of my old car decided?
A: Our team does a free evaluation of your old car at the showroom, checking its age, kilometres run, condition and documents. You get a written quote with no obligation to buy.

Q: Which documents are needed to exchange my old car?
A: Carry the RC book, insurance copy and your ID proof for the exchange. If your old car has a running loan, a clearance letter or NOC from the bank is also needed.

Q: Can I exchange a car of another brand?
A: Yes, we accept old cars of all brands in exchange. The exchange bonus up to Rs. 25,000 applies whichever brand your old car is.

Q: How long does the old car evaluation take?
A: A full evaluation of your old car takes about 30 to 45 minutes at the showroom. You receive the final quote the same day.

Q: How much time will delivery take after booking?
A: Delivery usually takes 2 to 4 weeks after booking. Your booking form mentions the expected delivery date for your car.

Q: What happens on the delivery day?
A: On delivery day we complete a pre-delivery inspection, finish your payment and paperwork, and give you a full demo of the car's features. Carry your ID proof and payment details.

Q: Which documents will I get at delivery?
A: At delivery you get the invoice, insurance policy, warranty booklet and free service coupons. The RC is issued by the RTO and is delivered to you after registration.

Q: Can I get the car delivered to my home?
A: Yes, home delivery within the city is available on request at no extra charge. Tell your sales advisor while booking if you want home delivery.

Q: Can delivery take longer for some models?
A: Yes, a few high-demand models like the Thar and the Defender can take longer than the usual 2 to 4 weeks. We confirm the expected delivery date in writing on your booking form.

Q: How many free services do I get with a new car?
A: You get 3 free services with a new car - at 1,000 km or 1 month, 5,000 km or 6 months, and 10,000 km or 12 months, whichever comes first.

Q: When should I service my car after the free services?
A: After the free services, service your car every 10,000 km or 12 months, whichever comes first. Regular servicing keeps your warranty valid and your car in good health.

Q: What is the cost of a paid service for a hatchback?
A: A general paid service for hatchbacks like the Swift, WagonR and Baleno starts at Rs. 3,999. The final bill depends on the work and parts your car needs, and we take your approval before any extra work.

Q: What is the cost of a paid service for an SUV?
A: A general paid service for SUVs like the Creta, Brezza and Scorpio-N starts at Rs. 5,499. We share a full estimate before starting work on your car.

Q: What are the workshop timings?
A: Our workshop is open Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 7 PM, and remains closed on Sunday. For service bookings, call +91 98765 43211.

Q: Do you provide pickup and drop for service?
A: Yes, we provide free pickup and drop for service within 10 km of the workshop. Book your service on +91 98765 43211 and tell us your pickup address.

Q: How much time does a general service take?
A: A general service takes about 4 to 5 hours, and the car is returned the same day. With free pickup and drop, you do not need to visit the workshop at all.

Q: Do you use genuine spare parts?
A: Yes, we use 100% genuine spare parts at our workshop. Every replaced part is billed transparently and your old parts are returned to you.

Q: What is the AMC plan? Is it worth taking?
A: The Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) covers your scheduled services for a fixed price, starting at Rs. 11,999 for 2 years. It protects you from service cost increases and is worth it if you service your car regularly with us.

Q: How do I book a service appointment?
A: Call our service team on +91 98765 43211 or write to care@velocitymotors.in to book a service appointment. You can also walk in, but a booked slot avoids waiting.

Q: Is wheel alignment included in the free service?
A: Wheel alignment and balancing are chargeable, while inspection, washing and fluid top-ups are free during your 3 free services. We always confirm charges with you before doing chargeable work.

Q: Will you service a car bought from another dealer?
A: Yes, our workshop services all cars of the brands we sell, even if the car was bought elsewhere. Call +91 98765 43211 to book your service.

Q: How much does denting and painting cost?
A: Denting and painting starts at Rs. 2,499 per panel at our workshop. The exact cost depends on the size of the damage, and we give you a free estimate before starting.

Q: Do you give a free estimate for accident repair?
A: Yes, accident repair estimates are completely free at our workshop. Bring your car any day between Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 7 PM, or call +91 98765 43211.

Q: Do you help with insurance claims for accident repair?
A: Yes, we help with the full claim process and offer cashless repairs with all major insurance companies. You only pay the charges your policy does not cover, like depreciation or the compulsory excess.

Q: Which documents are needed for an insurance claim?
A: For an insurance claim carry your RC book, driving licence, insurance policy copy and a filled claim form. For major accidents or theft, an FIR copy is also needed.

Q: How much time does dent and paint repair take?
A: A minor dent repair takes about 1 day, and a full panel paint takes 2 to 3 days. We confirm the delivery time when we give the free estimate.

Q: How much does windshield replacement cost?
A: Windshield replacement starts at Rs. 6,999, depending on your car model. Windshield damage is usually covered under your insurance, and we can process it as a cashless claim.

Q: Is there any warranty on repainting work?
A: Yes, repainted panels carry a 1-year paint warranty at our workshop. If the paint peels or fades due to our workmanship, we redo it free of cost.

Q: Can small scratches be removed without full painting?
A: Yes, minor scratches can often be removed with rubbing, polishing or a small touch-up at a much lower cost than full painting. Our workshop checks the scratch free of cost and suggests the cheapest correct fix.

Q: My car was damaged in an accident. It was not bought from you - can you repair it?
A: Yes, our workshop repairs accident-damaged cars of all the brands we sell, even if the car was bought elsewhere. Cashless repair depends on your insurance company and policy.

Q: What warranty do I get on a new car?
A: Every new car comes with a standard warranty of 3 years or 1,00,000 km, whichever comes first. You can extend the warranty up to 5 years for extra peace of mind.

Q: Can I buy or renew car insurance at your showroom?
A: Yes, we arrange new car insurance and renewals at the showroom itself. Policies bought through us get full cashless claim support at our workshop.

Q: Do you provide roadside assistance?
A: Yes, 24x7 roadside assistance is available for our customers for breakdowns, flat tyres, battery jump-start and towing. For help, call our service number +91 98765 43211 any time.

Q: How much does extended warranty cost?
A: Extended warranty up to 5 years is available at an extra cost that depends on your car model and the coverage period. Call our sales team on +91 98765 43210 for the exact price for your car.

Q: What are the showroom timings?
A: Velocity Motors showroom is open all 7 days, from 10 AM to 8 PM. Our workshop is open Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 7 PM, and is closed on Sunday.

Q: How can I contact Velocity Motors?
A: For sales, call +91 98765 43210; for service, call +91 98765 43211. You can also email us at care@velocitymotors.in - we reply within 1 working day.

Q: What documents do I need to buy a car?
A: To buy a car carry your Aadhaar card, PAN card, address proof and passport-size photographs. If you are taking a loan, income documents like salary slips and bank statements are also needed.

Q: How can I share feedback or raise a complaint?
A: Write to care@velocitymotors.in or call +91 98765 43210 with your feedback or complaint. We acknowledge every message and respond within 1 working day.

Eco driving & car care (keep the car efficient)

Share these awareness tips when owners ask how to use or take care of the car so it stays fuel-efficient, cleaner

and longer-lasting:

• Warm up gently — avoid high RPM for the first 1–2 km after a cold start.

• Smooth throttle and early upshifts save fuel; hard acceleration and late braking waste it.

• Keep tyre pressure at the door-sticker PSI — under-inflated tyres cut mileage and raise wear.

• Remove unused roof racks and heavy boot clutter; extra weight and drag reduce economy.

• Use AC wisely — recirculate after cabin cools; park in shade when possible.

• Follow the service schedule on time — clean oil, filters and plugs keep combustion efficient.

• Follow the service schedule on time — clean oil, filters and plugs keep combustion efficient.

• Prefer the recommended grade of engine oil and genuine filters for best economy and emissions.

• Idle less than 30–60 seconds when waiting; switch off if safe and legal for longer stops.

• Plan routes to avoid peak congestion when you can; steady 40–60 km/h city speeds are kinder on fuel.

• Check PUC, battery terminals and coolant level monthly; fix warning lights promptly.

• Wash with pH-neutral shampoo; avoid harsh chemicals on paint and plastic trims.

• For long trips, check tyre pressure cold, top up washer fluid, and carry a basic tool/kit.

If the customer wants a personal eco check (tyre pressure, filter due date, driving tips for their model), offer Book
